quests.name: The Crystal Skull
quests.description: Undead haunt the land, because the Deep Ones's crystal skull has been stone and hidden deep in the mountains to the East.

steps.name: Step 2 Find the Crystal Skull
steps.description: Find the Crystal Skull hidden in the wizards maze

quest_giver.start_dialog: Please fine adventures, the undead haunt our lands because the stupid Guild of Sorcerers has stolen the Crystal Skull and hid it deep in the mountains to the East. Please retrieve the Skull and give it back to the Deep Ones. Once the Skull is back in the hands of our masters, our dead can rest again.
quest_giver.end_dialog: Glad to see you have return and now our deceased friends and family can rest with The Deep One

quests.name: The Wandering Corpse
quests.description: The town's dead will not stay in their resting places, and it is up to you to put them to rest

steps.name: Step 1
steps.description: Put the Town's love ones... to rest

steps.name: Step 2
steps.description: Send the last ghost back to the spirit world

quest_giver.start_dialog: The town's dead will not stay in their resting places, can you please channel their spirits and put them to rest?
quest_giver.end_dialog: Thank you for your service to The Deep One

quests.name: Bats in the Inn
quests.description: The inn has become infested with Giant Bats

steps.name: Step 1
steps.description: Remove the bats from the Inn

quest_giver.start_dialog: Burp! Please sirs. madams. Ummm, gnomes? Doesn't matter.... But, please, I'm begging you! The Inn is infested by giant bats and I need to get my mead on. Can you please remove the pests. I will be eternally in your debt!

quests.name: Clear out the dungeons
quests.description: We have caves and abandoned ruins scattered throughout our lands and they are a danger. Destroy any monsters lurking in these dark spaces.

steps.name: Step 1 Clear out any two dungeons
steps.description: Clear out any two grottos or dungeons that you can find scattered throughout the map

quest_giver.start_dialog: Greetings, what a gang of youthful strong people. I could use a little bit of help. Now that I am getting up in years, I spend most of my time minding the children. Lately, too many children have been wandering into the grottos and ruins scattered all over the place here. Can you go into some of these spaces and clear out any dangerous monsters hiding in these pits? Make our lands safe for our children. Please! If you could just find any two dungeons to clear that would help me so much!
